press_references.value: ZAWYA: ENOC Group signs MoU with Allied Biofuels Holding for Sustainable Aviation Fuel supply cooperation

partnership_announcements.description: ENOC Group and Allied Biofuels Holding signed a Memorandum of Understanding to cooperate on the offtake and distribution of Sustainable Aviation Fuel and electro-synthetic SAF from Allied Biofuels' upcoming Uzbekistan biorefinery to local, regional and international markets, including forming a working group toward a long-term supply agreement.

press_references.value: ENOC, 7X sign deal to expand logistics and retail services across UAE

partnership_announcements.description: ENOC Group and logistics group 7X signed an MoU to form a strategic collaboration across e-commerce, q-commerce, logistics enablement, retail innovation and transport-ready solutions, including potential joint ventures, dark-store integration, NXN retail services within ENOC outlets, loyalty alignment and mobile refuelling for 7X fleets.

press_references.value: ENOC and MENA Biofuels sign strategic MoU at Dubai Airshow to accelerate UAE Sustainable Aviation Fuel ecosystem

partnership_announcements.description: ENOC Group signed a strategic MoU with MENA Biofuels to collaborate on offtake, supply, and distribution of UAE-produced Sustainable Aviation Fuel, tied to MENA Biofuels’ $300M Fujairah facility targeting up to 250M liters annually.

press_references.value: GEMS Education joins forces with ENOC’s YES Rewards as loyalty points exchange partner with Loyyal

partnership_announcements.description: ENOC Group’s YES Rewards and GEMS Education’s GEMS Rewards announced a points-exchange partnership, powered by Loyyal’s Xpand Point platform, enabling members to convert points between the programs for fuel, retail, lifestyle, and tuition fee benefits.

press_references.value: Enoc Group, RTA collaborate for use of green hydrogen in mobility

partnership_announcements.description: Enoc Group and Dubai's Roads and Transport Authority (RTA) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to explore the use of green hydrogen in mobility solutions in Dubai. This collaboration supports the Dubai Green Mobility Strategy 2030 and the UAE's green hydrogen economy.
